have hpt : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖𝓕 g n‖ ≤ K / (4 * π ^ 2) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) - α) ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    rw [fourier_mul_e]
    have h := hK (n - α)
    have hpos : 0 < (2 * π * ((n : ℝ) - α)) ^ 2 := by
      have := hαn n; positivity
    rw [show K / (4 * π ^ 2) * (1 / ((n : ℝ) - α) ^ 2) = K / (2 * π * ((n : ℝ) - α)) ^ 2 by
      field_simp; ring]
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hpos]; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: ‖𝓕 g n‖ ≤ K/(2π(n−α))² for every n, read off hypothesis hK on (2πt)²‖𝓕 f t‖.
